# fw-AD15N

Unmodified files from JieLi's AD15N SDK, copied from `sdk/app/post_build/sh55/mcu/` at commit
`f7c941d3ce67c76f72eec3ff40df9a088d11192e` of <https://github.com/Jieli-Tech/fw-AD15N>.

- `sh55loader.uart`: the RAM loader sent to the boot ROM.
- `uboot.boot`: the second-stage bootloader packed into flash images.
